text: I have now tried the phone line three times this evening and been cut off each time, so I will put it all down here. I am looking after my granddaughter tonight, she is 4 years old. She has had a temperature since yesterday afternoon and I took it again twenty minutes ago and it was 39.3. Her mother gave me the thermometer and I have used it properly, under the arm as she showed me. She also has a few insect bites on her legs from the garden, mosquitoes I think, which she keeps scratching because they itch, nothing more than that. I gave her a cool drink and she has had it. I am not someone who panics but 39.3 seems high to me and I would like someone with some knowledge to tell me whether she needs seeing tonight or whether I wait until her mother is back in the morning. I would appreciate a reply sooner rather than later.
